interface.shortDescription: Explain, discuss, specify, plan, execute, and finish changes.
interface.longDescription: A self-contained development workflow with first-principles technical explanations, memory-resolved documentation, persisted parallel-ready task graphs, persistent goals, sub-agent execution, local checkpoint commits, and explicit publication gates.
defaultPrompt: Explain this topic or drive the change through discussion, a parallel-ready plan, goal execution, and verification.
